_about: WP-S5 (2026-09-24): La Forge's coaches. One cast member of the world bible (app/prompts/serial/world_bible_paris_v2.json) per family of v2 units; every A1–A2 unit belongs to exactly one family. A v1 concept with an authored rule card keeps its card's speaker (app/data/grammar_rule_cards.json) as its coach, so the face on the card and the face on the feedback are the same. `openers` are the coach's first line of a free-use two-line scene when the item carries no line of its own (tu, or vous for the landlord). Characters: app/services/forge_coaches.py.
